officer.why: Someone whose kitchen light you can see, whose bin day you know, whose life you have tracked for years without ever having asked. Proximity without duty, which makes it the purest local case on the site.

predator.title: Gamergate
predator.why: Coordinated harassment of women in games, disguised as a debate about whether harassment should be allowed. The disguise is the mechanism: the argument was conducted entirely in good faith about a principle, and the harm was real.
